summary: Small/commentary-heavy traditions miss top-15 for distinctive in-corpus terms: 'Ahura Mazda'->zoroastrianism and 'Tiamat'->mesopotamian, despite terms appearing 100+/10+ times. Likely noisy embeddings (philological Gathas translation) + small-corpus crowding (mesopotamian 15 chunks). Recorded as knownGaps in golden-retrieval.json; promote to asserted gates once retrieval surfaces them.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: Golden-gate re-baseline (8673c77e) isolated a concrete reproducer for the transliteration half of this: 'sefirot' has a concept_aliases row and still misses top-15 ('Sephiroth' recalls jewish_mysticism at rank 1) — the graph leg surfaces the alias match but GRAPH_WEIGHT 0.3 loses the slot to vector hubs. A graph-weight sweep (RETRIEVAL_GRAPH_WEIGHT env, no redeploy) is the cheap experiment.
